verdict.rationale: Fin documents website syncing (a help article titled 'Sync and manage websites') and connecting content sources such as Zendesk, Confluence and Notion so Fin 'always' works from the same source of truth, which points to ongoing source sync rather than manual re-uploads. Nothing in the pack explicitly describes a recurring re-sync schedule or change-triggered sync. missing for 10: documented scheduled re-sync cadence, documented on-change/real-time sync for connected sources, detail on how each source type stays current, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, knowledge stays current automatically — the agent re-syncs sources on a schedule or on change, not via manual re-uploads

citations.quote: Bring content from your help center, Zendesk, Confluence, Notion, and more into one place, so Fin, Copilot, and your team always work from the same source of truth.
